lesson_text: Cross-Sectional Attention super-factor (5-seed set-attention, 327 factor-DB chars, net-active-Sharpe E2E loss + hard-concrete L0 gate). JUDGE_FAILED capital / essence Grade B / PIT CLEAN. Deployment universe (K200 union KQ150) forge-authoritative PORT_t 2.36<2.95, OOS 0.037<0.7 (band fail), Calmar 0.58<0.64 — graduation triple-HARD-fail. Signal provably real cross-sectionally (rank-IC t 4.41, HLZ+Bonferroni-18 PASS, placebo p=0) but does NOT transfer to realized net long-only active alpha on deployment universe (rank-IC>>PORT_t divergence, measurement-graduation Cycle-2). Mechanism strong in broad universe (allliq PORT_t 6.06) where peer-dispersion exists, but mega-cap deployment universe lacks it (UNIVERSE_MECHANISM_MISMATCH). Alpha is pre-2018-only (subperiod PORT_t 3.50->0.41->-0.31): cohort-wide KR post-2017 decay, NOT strategy-specific overfit — 6-super-factor-method common wall (KNS/IPCA/BMA/E2E/SPO+/XATTN all die post-2017). Cross-sectional attention (relative-positioning/crowding readout) does NOT break the post-2017 decay wall. Seed-ensemble denoises (0.87->1.41) but does not cross gate. Route: DPL feature / factor-rotation RCMA input (screen-tier). Not capital admission.
mechanism_hypothesis: 종목 알파는 자기특성뿐 아니라 같은 달 peer 대비 상대위치(crowding/consensus 구조 대비 편차)에 의존; attention이 월별 횡단 구조를 요약해 그 편차를 신호화. KR 배포 유니버스(대형주)에선 peer-dispersion 부족으로 메커니즘 약화.
